briefing: Markets were flat to slightly down today (NASDAQ -0.3%, S&P 500 -0.2%), a neutral session with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($189.29) is well below the $500 deployment threshold, so no new positions were opened despite 3 open slots; existing 7 positions were held unchanged to let stop-loss and profit-target rules do their job.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears. Today the portfolio's cash balance was too small to responsibly open a new position, so rather than forcing a trade on a neutral day, the cash was held in reserve for a clearer risk-on setup.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」(Dry Powder) 指預留在場邊、等待時機出手的現金。今日投資組合的現金餘額不足以穩健開立新倉位,與其在市況中性的日子勉強交易,不如保留現金,等待更明確的風險偏好訊號出現時再部署。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today with NASDAQ down 0.3% and the S&P 500 down 0.2%, a quiet, directionless session without a dominant catalyst. Trading volumes and price action suggest investors are in a wait-and-see mode rather than reacting to any single major headline. With no strong signal in either direction, this was a low-conviction day for the broader market.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢平淡,納指下跌0.3%,標普500指數下跌0.2%,未見明顯主導消息刺激市場方向。成交及價格表現顯示投資者普遍採取觀望態度,而非對個別重大新聞作出反應。在缺乏明確方向訊號下,今日屬於低信心的交投日子。
